availability.clock: Session arm clock; seal = accepted-final arrival wall on same clock; identical provider/text/policy/frontier across arms; all arms same expiry atomic accepted-final arrival seal
availability.definition: availability = measured flush wall of frontier sample (max of confirmation qualifying and stored frontier, i.e. emit) + unknown nonnegative model/event lag L >= 0; never assume source b time
availability.deadline: text-ownership seal = accepted-final arrival wall on same measured session clock
availability.max_permissible_lag: deadline_wall minus flush_wall(emit_sample), reported exactly per timed-text case/arm. Negative => too_late even at zero lag. Nonnegative => conditional receipt only (UNKNOWN lag, never causal PASS on lower bound alone)
availability.flush_rule: Existing send_audio queue-put is NOT flush. Experiment-local tee records actual websocket audio-send completion per chunk. Frontier of a sample = flush_end_wall of its chunk. Out-of-payload support frontier UNKNOWN, never extrapolated.
availability.unknown_semantics: UNKNOWN != too_late != absent != unsupported. Unmeasured lag fails acceptance; never invented pass.

evidence_policy.conservation: Accepted-token IDs and exact text derived from independent accepted records and compared across arms by ID multiplicity and exact text; DROP/DUP/TEXT negative controls prove detection; conservation distinct from ownership accuracy; copy/reuse entire accepted token ID/text independently per arm
evidence_policy.gt_match: Consumer ASR groups aligned to GT window words monotonically on normalized lexical form plus provider time support; unique alignments only; repeated-word ambiguity stays UNSCORED (enumerated, never greedily assigned); text conservation never equated with owner accuracy; denominators report matched/unmatched/mixed
evidence_policy.references: Actual stored references are GT-derived/oracle-mapped; never reinterpret as causal re-enrollment; full prior first event and unsupported scope recorded instead of evidence-absent conflation
evidence_policy.scored_set: Frozen 8-word GT window per case (4 left + 4 right, non-punc) scored in FULL (all 8; never favorable subset). in_span flags locate diagnostic scored span. Ownership: word-end <= arm boundary stays left (reference-owned), otherwise right (new/unknown); word strictly containing arm boundary stays intact and flagged uncertain/ambiguous, never split, never discarded. Fixed matched cohort per arm: identical scored words in, identical out.
evidence_policy.full_payload_set: Full CAPTURED payload GT words aligned separately with same monotonic lexical + time-support rules; reported matched/unmatched/mixed separately; gate uses fixed 8-window cohort only
evidence_policy.sensitivity: +-1280 source samples (one native 80ms frame) each direction, predetermined; sensitivity only, never optimized; no winner picking
evidence_policy.word_rule: Whole-word end_sample <= boundary stays left, otherwise right; straddlers intact + uncertain; consumer end rule; +-1280 diagnostics
